mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the previous 3 months signals increased economic activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where HOUST increases by more than 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous 3 months signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4% signals a restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where FEDFUNDS is above 4%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the previous month signals strong labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow by more than 0.5% month-over-month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points, it signals a robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increase > 0.5% MoM AND UNRATE decrease > 0.2pp
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where RSAFS increases by more than 0.5% MoM and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.2pp.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is above 3% year-over-year, it signals accommodative monetary policy supporting strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: accommodative monetary policy with strong GDP growth
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS is below 2% and GDPC1 YoY growth is above 3%.
